name: Cargo inspector
design: Short stocky male with rust-brown spotted hide, short domed skull and blunt mandibular tusks, short dense dreadlocks arranged behind neck. Broad utility leather waistcoat over heavy charcoal work tunic, worn square copper fasteners, bulky practical belt pouches, double layered short apron. Holds a small two-jaw cargo seal scanner downward in right hand, left hand relaxed; rolled sleeves and bare clawed feet.
